cases.question: When did the demonstration treaty enter into force and which parties signed first?
cases.objective: Two part historical question with dated fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: Dates stay tied to fixture provenance and unknown dates remain unknown.

treaty.title: Example fixture: treaty text archive
treaty.snippet: Fixture archive page with placeholder signature and entry into force dates for the demonstration treaty.

treaty.title: Example fixture: treaty ratification list
treaty.snippet: Fixture list of placeholder ratification order for the demonstration treaty parties.

cases.notes: Fixture dates describe the documents, not necessarily the events.

cases.question: What primary sources document the construction of the demonstration canal?
cases.objective: Primary source identification for an infrastructure project.
cases.expected_behavior: The report distinguishes primary documents from later commentary in the source comparison.

canal.title: Example fixture: canal construction records
canal.snippet: Fixture inventory of placeholder engineering reports and correspondence about the demonstration canal.

cases.notes: Single fixture keeps the corroboration claim honest.

cases.question: How did contemporaries describe the 1906 demonstration earthquake?
cases.expected_behavior: Passages from period accounts are quoted verbatim with their publication metadata.

earthquake.title: Example fixture: earthquake dispatch
earthquake.snippet: Fixture newspaper dispatch with placeholder damage descriptions from the demonstration earthquake.

earthquake.title: Example fixture: earthquake diary excerpt
earthquake.snippet: Fixture diary excerpt describing personal observations during the demonstration earthquake.

cases.notes: Very old dates must never be modernized by the pipeline.

cases.question: What role did the demonstration printing press play in spreading pamphlets?
cases.objective: Interpretive history question with default fixture content.
cases.expected_behavior: Interpretations are labeled as interpretations, not facts, in the claim table.

cases.question: Which censuses cover the demonstration province between 1850 and 1950?
cases.objective: Coverage enumeration across a bounded period.
cases.expected_behavior: The plan records the time boundary and the report states which periods lack coverage.

census.title: Example fixture: province census inventory
census.snippet: Fixture inventory listing placeholder census years and surviving volumes for the demonstration province.

cases.notes: The inventory date is later than the covered period by design.

cases.question: What do surviving letters reveal about trade routes in the demonstration archive?
cases.expected_behavior: The report separates what letters say from what archivists infer.

cases.question: How reliable are the demonstration chronicle dates for the 12th century succession?
cases.objective: Conflicting historical dates across two chronicle fixtures.
cases.expected_behavior: Both dates stay visible with their source ids and the report states that reliability cannot be settled automatically; the numeric contradiction scan only compares across distinct registrable domains, which same host fixtures do not provide.

chronicle.title: Example fixture: chronicle manuscript A
chronicle.snippet: Fixture manuscript entry dating the demonstration succession to 1187 with a placeholder scribe note.

chronicle.title: Example fixture: chronicle manuscript B
chronicle.snippet: Fixture manuscript entry dating the demonstration succession to 1191 with a placeholder marginal note.

cases.notes: Both urls stay on example.org per eval fixture policy; unit mismatch (years versus dates) must not create a false conflict.
